full_judgment: 8. Thus, to provide the benefit of the Rule 33(3)(b) the assessee must be a director of a company and he must work full time for one company only. Admittedly, the assessee is a director of more than one company. So, the only natural, legal and reasonable presumption would be that he must be giving at least some time and attention to the business of the other company as well. He must be attending the meeting of the Board of Directors of the other company i.e. the Sonear Engineering Limited also. Therefore, the assessee cannot be treated to be working full time for one company only i.e. the Sonear Laboratory Limited, Therefore, the assessee cannot be treated as an employee as provided in Rule 33(3)(b) of the Income Tax Rules. We find support of our view in the case of Commissioner of Taxes vs Mr Anisul Huque in Reference Application No. 38 of 2001 passed by a Division Bench presided over by his Lordship Mr Justice Md Awlad Ali.
